title: Build & Xplore
description: A ModPack focused on vanilla-like exploration and building.
body:
In this ModPack,\
you will explore, build, sleep and repeat!

I've put some mods together to create a ModPack you will surley love.\
Also if you PC is not strong enough,
this ModPack has some mods to increase performance,\
so no need to worry!

Being able to see some breath-taking views with the amazing mod distant horizons,
you will want to just download and play!\
With many mods that enchance the game while keeping it feel like vanilla Minecraft,\
you will not dislike this modpack.

While shader mods are not already installed due to a bug,\
feel free to customize the modpack however you want under the MIT liscence!

Features:
1. Amazing terrain generation
2. Amazing views made possible with DH mod
3. Lots of QOL mods to improve gameplay
4. Full customizabily available\
And much more!

For any help or bug reports, join my discord using this link: https://discord.gg/C9b3anUaP9
